title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is using condom while sex with wife permissible? 125645 views Q. As Salam-o Alaikum My aunt has an eight-year-old daughter who is suffering from severe Asthma. As long she keeps taking drugs(medicine) she remains healthy, but those drugs have severe side effects. My aunt is breastfeeding her one year old daughter currently. One of the doctors (Muslim) recommended to feed the elder daughter with mother?s breast milk, expressed in a cup. Now my aunt is doing this twice a week and her daughter is healthy and recovered. She (my aunt) wants to know is it Jaaiz? As we know Shariaah provides some relaxation under special circumstances. Regards 2014 views Q. Is television haraam? 4222 views Q. Halal or Haram 1730 views Q. As salaamualaikum wrwb Dear Mufti Saab, I work for company called Thomson Reuters. Its a company that provides financial news services to all the big time Financial Instututions ,Banks across the whole world. They have thier own software which is sold to these customers so that they can view all the informationabout Shares of all Halal and Haraam companies, Foreign Exchange and all bonds (fixed income group ie you invest some money and in return earn thorough interest or dividend). So these Banks buy these software to see the market trend and also after geeting inputs from this tools they to buy sell these bonds and trade on shares. Thomson Reuters does not provide and baised news about any Bond or share of the different companies in the market. But only broadcast all the above data to these banks who can run thier business on thier own terms. I work as Software Engineer who will prepare these software for Thomson and also provide better solutions to market this product to the whole Financial world. I have thought that in a way (indirectly) I am supporting the Banks and all Financial institutions to grow or run thier business. Kindly clarify if the money i earn out of these job is completely Halaal or impure. 2258 views Q. I am a university lecturer. I have applied to my university for study leave with pay. The university requires a bond that the person availing study leave will serve for the duration equal to the duration of study leave otherwise he/she will pay two times(double) of the salary that he will get during the period of study leave. This "two times condition" looks me as if involving Riba(sood). Please clear whether this is Riba. Can I sign this bond agreement with the university? If not then guide me what to do. Please reply me as early as possible because in three days I am to sign this bond. 1694 views Q. Invitation 1716 views Q. Accountant job is halal or haram 14651 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 58840 Country: India Title: میں انٹرنیٹ سروس کنٹرول کے ساتھ دیتاہوں، لیکن لوگ اس کا غلط استعمال بھی کرتے ہیں، Question: میں اپنے شہر میں انٹرنیٹ کنکشن فراہم کرتاہوں ، میں انٹرنیٹ سروس کنٹرول کے ساتھ دیتاہوں، لیکن لوگ اس کا غلط استعمال بھی کرتے ہیں، میں کنکشن دیتے وقت سب کو آگاہ کردتیاہوں کہ اس پر کوئی غلط کام نہ کرے ، اس کے باوجود اگر کوئی غلط کام کرے تو اس کا گناہ گار میں بھی ہوں یا نہیں؟ اور میرا بزنس جائز ہے کہ نہیں؟ Answer ID: 58840 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 326-326/Sd=7/1436-U اگر کنکشن دینے سے پہلے کسی کے بارے میں آپ کو ظن غالب ہو کہ وہ انٹرنیٹ کا ناجائز استعمال کرے گا تو ایسے شخص کو انٹرنیٹ کا کنکشن دینا مکروہ ہے اور اگر آپ کو پہلے سے اس کا کوئی علم نہ ہو، تو بعد میں جو شخص انٹرنیٹ کا غلط استعمال کرے گا، آپ اس کے گناہ میں شریک نہیں ہوں گے، ہکذا حققہ الفقہاء فی مسئلة التسبب علی المعصیة۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
